_description: Out-of-band components of the tap-web image (req-cicd-sbom-3): everything that enters the image outside a package manager, declared here and merged into the generated SBOMs during the single derivation. Schema: scripts/sbom/supplemental.schema.json (loader-validated). Lives beside the Dockerfile so a pin bump and its SBOM entry change in the same diff. File sha256 is NOT declared here - it is computed from the scanned artifact at generation time (per-arch, derive-once).

components._description: Self-built OpenSSL FIPS provider (CMVP #4282) - compiled from pinned source in the ossl-builder stage; the most compliance-significant binary in the image and invisible to every scanner. First artifact of the crypto-BOM discipline (req-fips-crypto-bom).
components.name: openssl-fips-provider

components._description: uv package manager binary, copied by digest-pinned COPY --from from the upstream astral-sh/uv image (Dockerfile). Its ~1012 embedded cargo-auditable crate entries are EXCLUDED from scans (req-cicd-sbom-2 - the tool's closure, not the artifact's); the executable itself is declared here. Version must match the Dockerfile COPY pin (reconciled by the req-cicd-sbom-12 guard when it lands).
components.name: uv

components._description: uvx (uv tool-runner companion binary), same upstream image and rationale as uv.
components.name: uvx
